title: Unique Binary Search Trees II
statement: Return all structurally unique BSTs storing values 1 through n. Example: n=3 returns five unique trees. Constraints: 1 <= n <= 8.
approach_name: Generate roots from every split value

title: Interleaving String
statement: Determine whether s3 can be formed by interleaving s1 and s2 while preserving the order of each source string. Examples: s1="aabcc", s2="dbbca", s3="aadbbcbcac" -> true; s3="aadbbbaccc" -> false.
approach_name: DP over prefixes of both source strings
